dict.string: Hair Compass uses the camera to capture standardized scalp and hair photos for check-ins, progress comparisons, and procedure follow-up tracking.
Hair Compass reads selected Health data like sleep, exercise, protein, and water intake to help you compare routine and lifestyle patterns with hair logs.
Hair Compass does not write Health data, but this key is included to clearly describe HealthKit use during review.
Hair Compass saves captured scalp and hair photos to support progress tracking, procedure follow-up, and clinician discussions.
Hair Compass accesses your photo library so you can attach scalp and hair images for check-ins, product analysis, and comparison sessions.
